title: Publish a recipe
description: A reviewer rates each new recipe draft from 1 to 5. A high rating publishes it, a low one sends it back, and a rating between goes to the founder.

question.text: Is this recipe ready to publish on the docs site?

sources.note: The reviewer's rating on each draft's publish decision

scale.meaning: The reviewer's rating of the draft, 5 for ready

note: Low tier, so a miss and a false alarm cost the same. A published recipe a reader reports as broken settles a false alarm. A recipe sent back and later published unchanged settles a miss.
